issue_request: FHIR-26899 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It asked to update the draft conditional Dosage extension so meetGoal.goal, whenTrigger.trigger, and precondition.condition could be represented as either a reference or valueString, and to fix the trigger/precondition reference targets to ActivityDefinition and ObservationDefinition where specified.
initial_application: Core commit 76ef92c3597ed1e3e2e1e7e398e6e772f385df64 applied FHIR-26899 to source/datatypes/dosage-extensions-spreadsheet.xml by adding string to meetGoal.goal and whenTrigger.trigger and by changing the reference targets. That application did not add string to precondition.condition. Later core commit dd468d4f17 removed extension spreadsheets from active R5 source, so the current core checkout has no active dosage-conditions extension definition to edit.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini actively lists DosageCondition as a datatype and maps it to the dosage page, while the [profiles] section has no active dosage-extensions or dosage-conditions entry. The FHIR Extension Pack now contains StructureDefinition-dosage-conditions.xml and StructureDefinition-dosage-minimumGapBetweenDose.xml; those definitions preserve string support for meetGoal.goal and whenTrigger.trigger, but precondition.condition remains only Reference(ActivityDefinition|ObservationDefinition). FHIR-40033 later declined to make the extension more prominent in core, and a 2026 Zulip discussion treats R6 DosageCondition and the Extension Pack extension as related but distinct.
reconciliation: No core source file was changed. The audit commit records that the remaining actionable FHIR-26899 gap belongs to the FHIR Extension Pack, which was read-only evidence for this worker and outside the core combined branch edit scope.
